Replace <repo> with the absolute path of this checkout; start an application side first (samples/ConsoleBridgeAppSample, or the WPF demo app). The relay's build output lives in the repository's shared output root (src/bin/<configuration>/net9.0); a plain `dotnet build src/Ason.Bridge.McpHost` may instead leave it under that project's own bin/. Servers that need authorization add "--key", "<key>" (or repeated "--header", "Name=Value").
